description: Find hidden/undocumented fields on a GraphQL type using field suggestion errors. Sends queries with intentionally misspelled field names to trigger GraphQL's field suggestion feature, which reveals valid field names. Also tries common sensitive field names directly. Returns: {discovered_fields: [str], suggestion_results: [...], direct_probe_results: [...]}. Side effects: Read-only POST requests. Sends ~25 requests.

known_field.description: A known field on this type to use in queries, e.g. 'id' or 'title'

query_name.description: Query name to use for fetching objects, e.g. 'getUser' or 'getBlogPost'

type_name.description: GraphQL type to probe for hidden fields, e.g. 'User', 'Post', 'BlogPost'

name: graphql_find_hidden
